record.rationale: Task6764KT preserves actual browser physical-face records and available source bytes. FontList groups real registered FontFaces and approved Local Font Access records without discarding actual descriptors, PostScript identity or lazy blob access. Embedded-font installation records the exact constructor bytes by actual FontFace identity in a JS WeakMap and returns independent byte copies. CSS FontFace bytes remain absent because the public FontFace API does not expose its source; CSS URL acquisition,cmap parsing,native face selection and visual preview integration remain unfinished. No glyph support or native font metrics are inferred from names, and no native lifetime machinery is implemented.
responsibilities: Actual constructor byte ownership keyed by real FontFace identity.
Independent source-byte reads without name-based physical-face or glyph metadata fabrication.

stackDivergence.rationale: The browser adapter retains constructor byte values by JS weak identity; native reference counting and explicit object lifetime mechanisms are erased.
